frozen_rule.signal: quote volume sum days t-7..t-1 divided by (quote volume sum days t-35..t-8)/4; high = long (high = long)
frozen_rule.portfolio: k = max(2, floor(n_eligible/5)); long top-k at +0.5/k each, short bottom-k at -0.5/k each (dollar-neutral, gross 1)
frozen_rule.eligibility: Point in time at each rebalance t (Monday 00:00 UTC): >= 35 daily bars closed before t, a bar for day t-1, >= 25 of the last 30 days present, 30-day mean daily quote volume (days t-30..t-1) >= $5M. A week is traded only if >= 8 memes are eligible; otherwise the week is flat and excluded from Sharpe and week counts (number of skipped weeks reported).
frozen_rule.execution: weights set at t, filled at close(t-1) (= open t) with costs, held to t+7 at constant notional (positions truncated at split end and force-closed there). No intra-week rebalancing or stops.

costs.taker: 5 bp per side (Binance USDT-M VIP0 taker 0.05%)
costs.slippage: per side by 30d mean daily quote volume: >= $1B 2 bp; $200M-1B 5 bp; $50M-200M 10 bp; < $50M 20 bp (same tiers as H-MOMENTUM; assumption)
costs.turnover: cost = |w_new - w_old| * (taker + slippage), charged to the coin-week leg being entered/resized, or to the leg being closed on exit
costs.funding: w * rate for every fundingRate print with calc_time in (t, t+7d] while held (long pays positive)
costs.delisting: data ends while held -> exit at last close, 2% of |w| penalty

universe.rule: CoinGecko 'meme-token' category (/coins/markets?category=meme-token), cached at data/raw/web/coingecko/listshort_meme_category.json, fetched 2026-10-05 for H-LISTSHORT; rule + identity overrides exactly as scripts/research/listshort_classify.py (symbol match after stripping 1000/1000000/1M prefixes; on symbol collisions the meme coin must be the largest-cap CoinGecko coin with that symbol; documented REMOVE/ADD identity corrections).
universe.note: Frozen list from the pre-registration (applied to the 900-symbol archive listing of 2026-10-05). The archive now also lists CTUSDT (not in that listing); it is not added (classification would need a new CoinGecko call, and a perp new on 2026-10-05 has no bars in the window).
universe.look_ahead: This is TODAY's (2026-10-05) category list applied to history. Coins that were memes but died and left CoinGecko (or were never categorised) are missing; coins that became famous are in. Mitigation: every Binance USDT-M perp that ever existed in the data.binance.vision archive for a classified coin is included, delisted ones too (delisted while held -> exit at last close, 2% penalty). Residual survivorship toward still-listed CoinGecko coins remains and is stated in the report.

window.why_end: latest Monday whose full week is in the archive: fundingRate is monthly-only and published through 2026-09; week t=2026-09-28 would need October funding

data: data.binance.vision futures/um monthly 1d klines + fundingRate 2026-04..2026-09 for the frozen meme symbols -> data/raw/web/memexs/holdout/; history from data/raw/web/momentum/{klines,funding} read-only
bar: per coin-week leg: n>=50, net>0, PF>1.2, net>0 without the 3 best legs
reported: pre-declared diagnostic: excluding identity-doubtful coins AI16ZUSDT, AIXBTUSDT, BUSDT, GHSTUSDT, GRIFFAINUSDT, MUSDT, ORDIUSDT, PEOPLEUSDT, ZEREBROUSDT
no_tuning: run once; nothing changed afterwards; a failure goes to reports/failures/memexs_holdout.md; a forward paper test (scripts/research/memexs_forward.py) follows regardless of the result
